discarded_attempts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one single rehabilitation assessment step photograph, 031 E-LOW-020 s01, seated relaxed medial foot arch appearance. Generate ONE image only, no panels.
Input images: reference-01, reference-02, reference-03 are identity, clothing, lighting and backdrop references, NOT pose references. Match the same adult East Asian woman with natural skin, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeved T-shirt and dark charcoal gray straight training trousers.
Scene/backdrop: seamless desaturated gray-blue studio background and floor, gentle studio light with natural soft contact shadows. Plain stable chair with light neutral seat and simple dark legs.
Primary request: she is seated steadily on the chair, knees bent approximately 90 degrees, thighs visibly supported by the seat; BOTH bare feet resting naturally flat on the floor, relaxed toes with no gripping and no deliberate short-foot contraction. Show the INNER/MEDIAL side of the near/test foot from heel to entire forefoot and toes, a natural relaxed arch above the floor. The other foot is visible slightly deeper in the frame, also resting flat.
Composition/framing: landscape 1536x1024 photograph, fixed low horizontal camera at ankle height, accurate medial side profile of test foot, toes pointing to picture right. Keep complete heel, arch, toes and clear floor contact, the ankle, calf and bent knee in frame; include enough of the seated upper thigh and chair seat on upper left to make seated posture unmistakable. Close clinical detail view, foot large and clearly legible, body above the waist may be cropped. Reserve modest clean background space. Camera is exactly perpendicular to the foot medial plane, no extreme wide-angle distortion.
Anatomy: natural adult foot proportions, one ankle connects continuously to one lower leg, five anatomically connected relaxed toes, heel and ball contact ground, no floating heel; barefoot trousers end above ankles. No enlarged or deformed toes. Neutral natural foot alignment.
Constraints: this is the seated comparator for later standing image; keep test foot at an easily repeatable floor position, heel lower-left region and toes lower-right. No rulers, no marker sticker, no overlaid text, no arrows, no diagram, no watermark, no collage. Identity and clothing match references; single exact physical pose.

items.final_prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: single photorealistic rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, step 01 of four of a very low two-foot jump and landing sequence. Generate only one image, portrait 1024x1536.
Input images: reference images 1, 2 and 3 are visual identity/style references only, not pose targets. Match this exact East Asian adult woman, facial features, natural slim-average adult body, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt and fitted dark charcoal-gray long trousers. Add plain unbranded white athletic shoes.
Scene/backdrop: seamless light gray-blue studio floor and backdrop, soft diffuse studio light with natural floor shadow. Empty level floor, no props, no platforms.
Composition/framing: fixed oblique full-body camera from her front-left side (a three-quarter side view), woman facing screen right. Camera at mid-body height with natural perspective, head and complete hands and both feet fully in frame; moderate comfortable margin over head and below shoes. Subject around 75% of canvas height, central. Feet clearly separately visible rather than occluded. Stable floor origin directly beneath her.
Exact pose: she is standing quietly upright at rest, both feet planted entirely flat on the same level floor, feet hip-width apart, knees comfortably straight but not hyperextended, trunk upright, arms and open relaxed hands naturally resting beside her thighs, gaze horizontal toward screen right. This is the standing preparation BEFORE bending or jumping. Feet under her hips, no forward step.
Anatomy and contact: believable limb proportions, continuous hip/knee/ankle anatomy, correct natural fingers, both shoes touch floor securely. Realistic photographic texture.
Constraints: only one woman, one pose, same reference identity/clothing/hair/light/background. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, motion trails, borders, collage, watermark, brand logos, equipment or heavy weights. Do not copy the references' raised arm poses.

Image 1 is the EXACT EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is supporting identity/reference only. Return ONE portrait 1024x1536 photograph.
Make just ONE small correction to Image 1: reveal her currently occluded FAR-SIDE HAND by moving the far arm a little away from her body. She must have exactly two natural arms and two natural hands. Keep the visible near-side arm and hand in their existing relaxed backward swing. Adjust the far-side elbow/forearm naturally with a small backward and outward swing, so the COMPLETE far hand, including its entire fingers and wrist outline, is visible against clear gray-blue background behind/alongside the hips. Put this second hand slightly higher than and separated from the existing near hand, with a clear visual gap, not overlapping it. The far forearm must connect naturally to the far elbow; no inverted or backward joints. Both hands softly relaxed, not fists. A little asymmetry in arm swing is acceptable.
Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE exactly: same head and gaze, torso lean, hips, shallow bent knees, both complete white athletic shoes fully planted on original floor locations, natural body/limb scale and proportions, same woman/face/black ponytail/white T-shirt/charcoal trousers, fixed oblique full-body camera facing screen right, original crop/subject position, identical gray-blue seamless floor/backdrop, soft light and shadows. No other pose change, no camera movement, no moving feet, no airborne soles, no deeper squat. It must still be shallow preparation BEFORE jumping, not an arm exercise.
No added text/arrows/numbering/labels/logos/watermarks/collage/borders/props or extra limbs.
